title: Sberbank (SBRCY) Deep Dive Analysis
summary: Dollar funding relief and Russian bank value.
coverage_note: All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

claims.reason: Texas explicitly cited increasing hospitalizations and positivity when reversing bar and restaurant opening. This verifies the economic restriction channel, while the article correctly leaves subsequent death rates uncertain rather than predicting them.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: Executive action to contain COVID-19
evidence.finding: Texas cited rising positivity and hospitalizations, closed most bars and reduced restaurant capacity to 50% from June 29.

claims.reason: Simultaneous hiring and layoffs are plausible, but claims count benefit weeks and may include backlogs. Comparing those directly to establishment payroll jobs also mixes persons, jobs and coverage; the text acknowledges a mismatch but not its full measurement cause.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: COVID-19 oversight report
evidence.finding: GAO found continued-claim totals counted weeks, not unique beneficiaries. DOL clarified this in December 2020; backlogs could produce several weeks per person in one report.

evidence.title: Pandemic impact on May employment statistics
evidence.finding: The misclassification discussed concerned household-survey labor-force status. Establishment payrolls count workers paid for any part of the reference pay period, even when absent; unpaid absentees are excluded.

claims.reason: Full payroll recovery took until July 2022 in the contemporary release. The rapid initial rebound did not invalidate the multi-year completion forecast. This does not prove a conventional credit-cycle mechanism drove all delays.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: July 2022 Employment Situation release
evidence.finding: The release reported payroll employment and unemployment rate had returned to February 2020 levels in July 2022. This is a publication-vintage recovery date, not a claim about subsequently revised payroll history.

claims.reason: The Federal Reserve documented severe offshore dollar-funding pressure in March 2020 and the relieving role of central-bank facilities. Trade receipts are one funding source, not the only way borrowers can service dollar liabilities.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: Financial Stability Report: funding risk
evidence.finding: March 2020 global dollar funding pressures increased as wholesale funding contracted and hedging/credit-line demand rose. Swap-funded auctions helped foreign banks meet commitments and build liquid assets without selling dollar assets.

evidence.title: June 2020 Monetary Policy Report, part 2
evidence.finding: Investors sold longer Treasuries and MBS for liquid assets; Treasury bid-ask spreads widened and dealer balance-sheet constraints impaired intermediation. Purchases and lending aimed to restore market function.

claims.reason: Providing dollars through foreign central banks can reduce forced liquidation and funding premia. The specific $300 bn foreign-sale attribution and every line utilization figure need separate data; effectiveness does not mean swaps alone caused the recovery.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

claims.reason: For an unlevered standalone sleeve, its loss cannot exceed its invested capital. This is a bounded portfolio identity, not evidence that a basket of cheap countries must have positive expected returns.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Portfolio loss contribution is position weight times asset loss, absent leverage or correlated additional exposures.

assumptions: No additional capital commitment, recourse liability or short exposure
Asset value cannot fall below zero
proof.derivation: At weight w, value can decline from w times initial portfolio capital to zero. Direct loss is at most w times initial capital. Correlated losses elsewhere remain separate.

assessment: Sberbank's domestic profitability thesis had support; the investor-access risk overwhelmed a simple low-multiple valuation. The ruble five-year base case missed, while the explicit sanctions warning was borne out. Remaining ADR holders received a nonzero liquidation entitlement in 2026, so calling the position universally worthless would also be wrong. International-equity decade forecasts remain open, with unfavorable five-year relative evidence.
verification_limitations: Retrieved 2026-11-07; publication-date wording is not authenticated.

Public market series are available, but not every investment claim has a defined horizon or reconciled corporate-action-adjusted return. Unverified outcomes remain unscored; macro data use latest available vintages.
